plan.title: docs(labels): consumer issue-label kit should mention optional security routing label

narratives.Description: Consumer issue-label kit omits optional portable security routing label. Under no-invention catalog rule, consumers and agents cannot create security for advisory security-officer routing. Thin docs fix: optional project routing note only; not full AppSec taxonomy.
narratives.Overview:
## Capability gap

The **consumer issue-label kit** (`content/docs/consumer-issue-label-kit.md` / deposit `.deft/core/docs/consumer-issue-label-kit.md`) documents core, role (`epic` / `status:tracker` / `status:child`), and triage/mirror labels — but does **not** mention an optional portable **`security`** routing label.

## Why it matters

Consumers that route security-axis PRs/issues to an advisory Security Officer (or similar) need the label to **exist on the forge** and appear in the consumer catalog. Under the kit rule **⊗ invent labels outside the catalog**, omitting `security` from both the recommended kit and any “optional project routing” note causes:

1. Catalogs cloned from the kit to drop `security`
2. Agents to refuse creating/applying it (no-invention)
3. Label-based security review routing to silently fail

This is a **docs/kit completeness** gap, not a mandate that every consumer must create `security`.

## Proposed thin fix

In consumer-issue-label-kit.md, add a short **Optional project routing** (or equivalent) subsection, e.g.:

- Optional: `security` — marks security-axis issues/PRs for advisory security review routing when the project has that path
- Create on forge only if used; document in the consumer’s `.github/ISSUE_LABELS.md`
- Not a merge gate; not a substitute for review bots; not maintainer AppSec taxonomy import

Keep out of Core always-recommend if undesired — **optional** is enough.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Kit mentions optional `security` (or deliberate “out of scope / project-only” note so consumers know to extend catalogs)
- [ ] No full maintainer AppSec taxonomy import
- [ ] Deposit path updates with normal release

## Related

- Consumer kit source: #2611 area
- Maintainer taxonomy boundary: #2609
- Not: #3007 maintainer AppSec playbook (different surface)

## Non-goals

- ⊗ Require every consumer to create `security`
- ⊗ Import maintainer-only security facet trees
- ⊗ Change Greptile/SLizard behavior
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer project maintainer, I want the issue-label kit to document an optional security routing label, so that projects with security review routing can create that label without inventing outside the catalog.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Edit content/docs/consumer-issue-label-kit.md to add Optional project routing subsection for security.
2. Keep optional; do not add to core always-recommend; no maintainer AppSec taxonomy import.
3. CHANGELOG Unreleased docs note; ensure deposit path will pick up via normal release.

narrative.Acceptance: Given the consumer issue-label kit, when an operator reads it, then an optional project routing note documents the security label purpose create-only-if-used and not a merge gate.
